lipTrillOctave.title: Octave Lip Trill
lipTrillOctave.description: Use an easy lip trill over an octave arpeggio to organize airflow and find a natural vocal setup.

tongueTrillFive.title: Tongue-trill Five-note Scale
tongueTrillFive.description: Use a continuous tongue trill over a five-note scale while keeping the throat free and pitch changes connected.

mumOctave.title: Mum Octave Connection
mumOctave.description: Use a speech-like Mum over an octave arpeggio while keeping the lower and upper registers connected.

gugFive.title: Gug Five-note Connection
gugFive.description: Use a clear G onset on a five-note scale to keep each pitch steadily connected.

geeLongScale.title: Gee Long-scale Transition
geeLongScale.description: Carry Gee through a long scale while staying light and connected across the passaggio.

nayOctave.title: Nay Octave Transition
nayOctave.description: Use a moderately bright, speech-like Nay over an octave arpeggio to connect both sides of the passaggio.

lipTrillTwelfth.title: Twelfth Lip Trill
lipTrillTwelfth.description: Cross an octave plus a fifth on a lip trill to expand comfortable range with relatively low load.

nooOctave.title: Noo Octave Scale
nooOctave.description: Use a narrow Noo over a full octave scale to keep pitch and register continuity through a longer pattern.

nayFive.title: Nay Five-note Mix
nayFive.description: Use a bright but moderate Nay over a five-note scale to balance speech-like clarity with head participation.

mumOctaveRepeat.title: Mum Octave Builder
mumOctaveRepeat.description: Repeat Mum at the octave to keep a natural, connected setup after ascending.

geeStaccato.title: Gee Staccato Arpeggio
geeStaccato.description: Use light Gee syllables on a staccato octave arpeggio to build quick onsets and interval accuracy in mix range.

voiceprintConsent.title: Voice Data Authorization Agreement
voiceprintConsent.readAndAgree: I have read and agree to
voiceprintConsent.permissionDescription: For local recording and real-time pitch analysis
voiceprintConsent.introduction: This agreement explains how SingJourney handles your voice information in the pitch meter and practice recording features. Please decide whether to agree after reviewing it.
voiceprintConsent.section1Content: SingJourney accesses your microphone only for real-time pitch analysis, practice recording, playback, and saving or sharing initiated by you.
voiceprintConsent.section2Content: Audio and pitch analysis are processed locally on your device and are not uploaded to SingJourney servers. They are not used for identity recognition, and no voiceprint identification template is extracted or created.
voiceprintConsent.section3Content: Recordings and pitch data remain only on the current device until you delete them, clear Mini Program data, or remove the relevant client. Audio is passed to WeChat for sharing only when you initiate that action.
voiceprintConsent.section4Content: You may decline this agreement, clear the checkbox, or disable microphone access in WeChat settings. You cannot start a new recording after declining or withdrawing, but other features such as browsing remain available.
voiceprintConsent.section5Content: You may view or delete saved content from the recordings page at any time. Clearing Mini Program data also removes local recordings and the stored agreement record.
